title: D-024 Amendment 37 AD-093 defect: controller-authoritative git-state checkpoint enrichment (journey-5 invalid_checkpoint)
objective: Smallest durable fix for the journey-5 invalid_checkpoint (opus worker omitted branch/worktree/starting_sha/current_sha). Make those four CONTROLLER-AUTHORITATIVE checkpoint-envelope fields (R462): a new tools/agent_supervisor/checkpoint_envelope.py resolves them from the dispatch context (expected branch/worktree, pre-dispatch starting_sha) + a fresh read-only git measurement (observed branch/worktree/current_sha), cross-checks expected==observed (unexpected branch / wrong worktree / unreadable / ambiguous SHA => FAIL CLOSED, R464), and enriches the worker checkpoint dict BEFORE final validation (R463): fill when absent, EXACT NORMALIZED MATCH when the worker supplied any (mismatch => fail closed). claude_runner.extract_checkpoint split into find_checkpoint_candidate + validate_checkpoint so run_unit enriches between them and records the ORIGINAL worker checkpoint bytes + the list of controller-added fields (R465, never presented as worker-authored); loop.py measures starting_sha pre-dispatch, provides the git_head_reader, builds the envelope, and audits which fields were added. NO prompt-only fix, NO bare Opus retry (R461); NO change to semantic completion/evidence/status/review/advancement/worktree-isolation/effect/budget/owner-gate requirements (R466). Removal-sensitive tests for all 8 named scenarios (R467). Test sequence R468: affected checkpoint/runner/loop/recovery packs first, then ONE golden + ONE whole suite once at the final identity, then independent G3/G4 + DCV; no broad 17-defect survey. Preserve PAUSED_RECOVERY journal/audit 104/pending 0/worktrees/budgets/owner-touch/model pin opus-4-8/manifest c228b7ca/PR #241 (R469). After accept + ONE R247 recert, present targeted proof + clear-recovery + one parse-validated start with a fresh run id (R470, present-only, R471). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: journey-5 invalid_checkpoint (AD-093 reproduced defect / failed acceptance scenario; D-024-R394/R460).
business_reason: Owner Amendment 37: the first live commissioning cycle stopped no_valid_checkpoint because opus omitted controller-knowable git-state fields; make them controller-authoritative to return to commissioning without weakening fail-closed checkpoint integrity.
inputs: tools/agent_supervisor/models.py (ClaudeCheckpoint required fields incl the four git-state ones)
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/checkpoint_envelope.py (NEW: normalize + resolve authoritative envelope with git cross-checks + enrich-or-match-fail-closed)
tools/agent_supervisor/claude_runner.py (extract_checkpoint split into find_checkpoint_candidate + validate_checkpoint; run_unit enriches + records original bytes + added fields)
tools/agent_supervisor/loop.py (pre-dispatch starting_sha measurement + envelope construction + git_head_reader + enrichment audit event)
tools/test_agent_supervisor_checkpoint_envelope.py (NEW: removal-sensitive tests for all 8 scenarios incl the journey-5 opus fixture)

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: All four git-state fields MISSING from the worker checkpoint -> controller enriches all four from authoritative sources (dispatch expected branch/worktree, pre-dispatch starting_sha, fresh git current_sha); checkpoint validates; added_fields lists all four; original worker bytes preserved.
Partially missing (some supplied, some absent) -> absent filled, supplied matching pass; added_fields lists only the filled ones.
Worker supplied all four and they MATCH the authoritative values (normalized) -> pass, added_fields empty.
Each supplied field MISMATCHING (branch, worktree, starting_sha, current_sha in turn) -> FAIL CLOSED (invalid_checkpoint), never enriched-over.
Unreadable / ambiguous git state (git error, non-40-hex SHA, detached/unknown branch) -> FAIL CLOSED, no enrichment.
Normalized Windows worktree paths: forward/back slashes + case differences that are the same path MATCH; genuinely different worktree FAILS closed.
The EXACT journey-5 opus checkpoint fixture (missing the four fields) is now safely enriched and validates; a mutant that drops the enrichment call makes it RED (removal-sensitive).

No false completion/advancement: enrichment fills ONLY the four envelope fields and never touches status/summary/claims/evidence/review; a BLOCKED/FAILED worker status is preserved; advancement still requires the unchanged semantic checks.

progress_log.message: Claimed; investigation complete (extract_checkpoint L743 validates inside run_unit L1490; four git-state fields required in ClaudeCheckpoint; loop has authority.branch/worktree; starting_sha must be measured pre-dispatch). Implementing checkpoint_envelope.py + wiring.
